All checks complete. The work is done — here's the report.

## Status: partial (code + tests written, compile/test unverifiable in this environment)

**Why partial, not complete:** the task's Done-criterion (1) — `cargo check --locked` — cannot pass on this machine for reasons unrelated to the change: the pinned `gpui 0.2.2` build script compiles Metal shaders via `xcrun metal`, which is absent (CommandLineTools only, no Xcode). The failure occurs in the dependency's build script before any app crate compiles, so the unmodified base fails identically. I also tried cross-checking for Linux, but `rustup target add` fails with "No space left on device". No commit was made, per instructions — changes are uncommitted in the worktree.

## Summary

Zed-style header rework, touching only tree-header view + title/chrome wiring (no `nav.rs`, no `Cargo.toml`/themes/keymaps):

- **`src/shell/sidebar.rs` (`render_dock` header):** the tree header no longer renders the vault/folder name. The new-note / new-folder / fold-unfold icons moved ahead of the title handle, so they are left-aligned. The `tool-title-tree` element is kept but empty for `Mode::Tree` (now `flex_1`), so it still serves as the window-drag handle and the dock-drag source (drag card still names the vault; `docks.rs` drag-by-title test unaffected). All other tools' headers are byte-identical in behavior.
- **`src/shell/render.rs`:** the native window title (via the existing `set_window_title` call — the GPUI-native path on macOS/Windows, also sets the WM name on Linux) is now folder-first with the app name kept: `{note} — {vault} — Inkuno`, `{vault} — Inkuno` for an empty note, `{note} — Inkuno` with no vault, plain `Inkuno` with neither. The client-drawn handle strip (Linux single-tab case) now centers the vault name (`window-title` selector) in the corner pane's top row, clearing the window buttons; the strip remains a drag handle (verified in GPUI 0.2.2 source that a handler-less `div` inserts no hitbox, so nothing underneath is occluded).
- **`src/shell/tabs.rs`:** same centered vault-name overlay in the corner group's tab bar (multi-tab case), right-cleared by `PILL_ROOM`, pointer-transparent; bar root made `.relative()` to anchor it.
- **`src/shell/mod.rs`:** initial `TitlebarOptions.title` is `{vault} — Inkuno` (or `Inkuno`) so the native title is correct before the first frame updates it.
- **Tests (`src/shell/tests/window.rs`):** `window_buttons_leave_the_header_and_the_title_clear` now also asserts the tree icons sit left of/at the header's left end, `window-title` is drawn, and `s.title == "Titre — {vault} — Inkuno"`; `window_buttons_have_the_top_row_to_themselves` asserts `window-title` is drawn in the tab bar clear of the pill.

## Files changed (uncommitted, worktree `ui-tree-header`, branch `agent/ui-tree-header`)

`src/shell/sidebar.rs` (+59/−55), `src/shell/render.rs` (+25/−7), `src/shell/tabs.rs` (+31/−1), `src/shell/mod.rs` (+7/−1), `src/shell/tests/window.rs` (+39). Diff stat: 5 files, 167 insertions, 59 deletions.

## Verification output + what could not run

- `cargo check --locked`: **could not run** — `gpui@0.2.2` build script fails (`xcrun: unable to find utility "metal"`); fails identically on base.
- `cargo test` (incl. affected GUI-unit tests): **could not run** — same blocker.
- `rustfmt --edition 2024 --check` on all five touched files: **clean** (parses; only pre-existing diffs in untouched `benches.rs`/`panes.rs` remain). This confirms syntax but not types.
- Manual type/API audit against gpui 0.2.2 sources and in-repo precedents: `.children(Option<Div>)` (cf. `help.rs:580`), `SharedString::from(String)` (cf. `sidebar.rs:919`), `HitboxBehavior` (handler-less overlay inserts no hitbox), `Mode: Copy`, `set_window_title(&str)`, test-only `shell.client` forcing client rendering — all check out.
- Screenshots: impossible headless. Resulting layout: tree header = `[+note][+folder][fold][————empty drag space————][dock buttons…]` with no text; top row (Linux) = vault name centered in semibold 13px soft color in the corner pane's strip/tab bar, window buttons top-right; native title e.g. `Titre — inkuno-pill-12345 — Inkuno`.

## Open questions / follow-ups

1. **Right dock open on Linux:** `corner_group()` returns `usize::MAX` then, so no pane draws `window-title` (native `set_window_title` still fires). If desired, a follow-up could draw the vault name in the right dock's header area.
2. **Crowded tab bars:** with many long tabs, the centered overlay can visually overlap tab text (it never blocks clicks). A follow-up could hide it when tabs fill the bar.
3. **Guide:** `book/src/compatibility.md:12` ("drag the window by … the title of the panel") and `navigation.md:48-49` remain functionally true; I left `book/` untouched — say the word if you want a sentence noting the folder now lives in the window title.
4. Needs a real `cargo check --locked` + `cargo test --locked` on a machine with Xcode (or Linux CI) before merge.
